risks: Minimal: review of reports already produced; no patient contact.
consent: Not required for a service evaluation of report content; referrers complete the questionnaire voluntarily and anonymously.
data: Report text is rated inside the reporting system; the study spreadsheet holds report numbers only and is deleted after the evaluation.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: report completeness is checked for examinations of patients with limited English or from outlying hospitals where referral information is thinner; no individual radiologist's performance is reported.
effectiveness: Tells the department whether the template works as intended.
partnerships: Radiology governance group, surgical and emergency department leads.
rebPath: Service evaluation determination SE-2026-061 (2026-09-02); no ethics review required. Any publication will describe the determination.
limitations: No concurrent comparison; checklist designed with the template.
summary: Service evaluation with anonymous referrer views and no individual performance reporting.
